one_liner.zh: 本地 Git 长期记忆、检索与设置管理
one_liner.en: Local Git-backed long-term memory and retrieval

local: Node.js 22 or newer for the DSH runtime
Python 3 and Git are used by host-side repository helpers
A local Git memory repository; defaults under ~/.dsh/storages/memory

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: DSH home directory; the default memory repository is under this location

config_items.name: DSH_MEMORY_ROOT
config_items.description: Optional absolute path for the local memory repository

config_items.name: DPSK_PYTHON3
config_items.description: Optional Python 3 executable override for host helpers

packages/dsh-memory/lib/index.js and sibling package copies; the aggregate dsh-git-memory bundle is the configured runtime entry

completeness.reason: Host registers prompt memory and read-only retrieval tools; repository service and settings UI include preview, migration, recovery and clear flows.

code.reason: Modules separate retrieval, metadata, locking and sync; operations return stable errors and bound reads, though the implementation is JavaScript without static types.

docs.reason: README and docs cover install, configuration, storage, API behavior, recovery, privacy and compatibility with examples.

maintenance.reason: The list reports 111 commits and a 2026-10-10 push, about four weeks before this analysis date.

tests.reason: The extracted inventory reports 41 test files and CI; workflow runs a broad local integration suite.

quality.notes: Scores for tests and maintenance follow extracted repository metadata; plugin code and tests were not executed.
